$comment: Reviewed SLO baseline for scripts/restore-drill.js. Every entry carries a written reason, never a bare number: a duration without the dataset and machine it was measured on is not an SLO. Rewritten deliberately with `node scripts/restore-drill.js --update`, which refuses to write from any run that found a correctness failure or injected a fault — the diff is meant to be reviewed. Exceeding toleranceFactor is reported as a WARN and does NOT fail the drill; see FR-8 in the runbook for why.

inventory.reason: Measured by the drill on the local Docker stack after the migrator applied 0_baseline and the demo seed ran (tenant demo, school VOLTAIRE). tableCount drift is a hard failure: a table dropped from schema.prisma vanishes from the source AND the restore and would compare equal for ever. Row totals move with the seed and are reported, not enforced.

ledger.reason: Every directory under apps/api/prisma/migrations must come back in the restored _prisma_migrations, finished and not rolled back. A restore without the migration history is a restore of the data, not of the database. 20260809120000_tenant_timezone was added by S-E04-5 (additive `tenant.timezone`, expand-only) and is recorded here by hand as part of that review — this list is a reviewed record, so a migration reaching disk without reaching this file is exactly the drift the check exists to catch.

dumpMs.reason: Measured by `node scripts/restore-drill.js --update` — pg_dump -Fc of the whole database. Windows 11 host, Docker Desktop, postgres:15-alpine, the seeded demo dataset recorded under `inventory`.

restoreMs.reason: Measured by `node scripts/restore-drill.js --update` — pg_restore --exit-on-error into a fresh scratch database. Windows 11 host, Docker Desktop, postgres:15-alpine, the seeded demo dataset recorded under `inventory`.

verifyMs.reason: Measured by `node scripts/restore-drill.js --update` — rebuilding the manifest from the restored database and comparing it. Windows 11 host, Docker Desktop, postgres:15-alpine, the seeded demo dataset recorded under `inventory`.

totalMs.reason: Measured by `node scripts/restore-drill.js --update` — the whole cycle, including manifest builds and cleanup. Windows 11 host, Docker Desktop, postgres:15-alpine, the seeded demo dataset recorded under `inventory`.

toleranceFactor.reason: Wide on purpose. The measurement is a developer laptop against a Docker volume under variable load; a tight factor would make the drill flake, and a gate that flakes is re-run until green instead of read. Exceeding it is a WARN, never a non-zero exit.
